Real: Fulton County admitted that ~315,000 early votes were certified without required poll worker signatures on tabulator tapes. This is an actual procedural violation. The State Election Board voted 3-0 to refer it to the AG's office, and someone is likely getting fined (not jail, bc it wasn't criminal).
